messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=inference-hotpath severity=high (p99 latency > 2.5s for 6m). Incident ID: PD-88213.

maria: acked — oncall (maria) taking this. I'll do a quick blast radius check.

kevin: thanks. i'm checking p95/p99 dashboards and rollout traces now. linking grafana: https://grafana.redwood/infer/hotpath

maria: seeing p99 jump in eu-west and us-west regions. tail requests up ~3x, cpu on sidecars jumping.

kevin: looks like a small batch of noisy customers spiking token lengths — KV cache hit drops to 20% on a subset of nodes.

ingrid: @maria can you confirm whether this is new model roll or traffic shift? I don't see a deploy in last 30m.

maria: no deploys. routing shows increased traffic from tenant=internal-search-job.

sre-lead: tagging in. If KV cache is thrashing we should attempt two mitigations in parallel: 1) scale inference pool by +20% to buy headroom, 2) enable short-term prefix caching fallback for hotkeys.

ops-liaison: scaling now: aws autoscaler trigger -> request +6 instances for eu-west/us-west pools. running: ./tools/scale-gpu --pool hotpath-eu --count +3 && ./tools/scale-gpu --pool hotpath-us --count +3

maria: started cache fallback experiment: feature-flag short_prefix_cache=true on route inference.v1; applying via rollout service.

incident-bot: Action recorded: scale request submitted by ops-liaison at 1719504384. Feature flag rollout started by maria at 1719504402.

kevin: running quick grep on logs to find hotkeys: 
```
# noisy keys last 10m
jq .requests[] | group_by(.key) | map({key: .[0].key, count: length}) | sort_by(-.count) | .[0:10]
```
Found hotkey: "search-heavy-xyz" ~ 42% of requests on affected nodes.

ingrid: can we route that tenant to dedicated pool temporarily? ops-liaison, any objections?

ops-liaison: we have spare dedicated capacity in eu-dedicated-2. Will move tenant via routing override: ./tools/reroute-tenant --tenant internal-search-job --to eu-dedicated-2 --ttl 15m

maria: reroute applied. Verifying traffic shift...

kevin: metrics updating — p99 dropping in eu-west from 3.1s -> 1.8s within 90s of reroute. us-west still slow but autoscaler completing.

customer-success: reached out to internal-search-job contact to notify about temporary reroute. No reported end-user impact yet, internal job may see rate-limiting.

maria: autoscaler finished, additional GPUs online. us-west p99 now 1.6s. overall p99 back to ~1.7s.

sre-lead: good — primary mitigations working. keep reroute in place for 15m and monitor. we'll capture metrics for post-incident.

kevin: quick note — temporary rollback of short_prefix_cache will be needed if we see degraded quality. i'm watching model output quality dashboards.

maria: ack. leaving monitoring hooks and alert suppression for the next 20m to avoid autopager noise. incident-bot, please suppress duplicate p99 alerts for this incident id for 20m.

incident-bot: Suppression applied: PD-88213 duplicates suppressed until 1719505920 by maria.

ops-liaison: leaving routing override active. will auto-clear at TTL or can clear manually: ./tools/clear-reroute --tenant internal-search-job

customer-success: flagging for post-incident outreach to tenant — explain temporary reroute and offer mitigation guidance.

maria: we're in steady state. p99 stable < 2s. handoff to kevin for post-incident write-up. I'll update rotation calendar and hand over any remaining tasks.

kevin: taking post-incident. will open incident doc and schedule 1hr blameless review. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

sre-lead: recommend follow-ups: analyze KV cache hit patterns, consider tenant-side batching limits, and evaluate autoscaler thresholds for faster spin-up.

maria: closing thread — will mark PD-88213 resolved in 10m if no regressions.

incident-bot: PD-88213 marked acknowledged->resolved at 1719504729 (resolved by maria).

kevin: copying notes to incident tracker: https://confluence.redwood/incidents/PD-88213

maria: good job team. short debrief later. :coffee:
